question: Point out the correct answer regarding alteplase:

options.opa: It is effective if it is administered in the first 10 hours after the thrombotic episode.
options.opb: Its effectiveness is similar to that of calcium and sodium blockers.
options.opc: It is administered intravenously and regains blood flow by undoing the thrombus.
options.opd: It is an antagonist of the glutamic NMDA receptor.
